title: Signal: Content-Security-Policy without form-action
scope: Single Content-Security-Policy header value: the named directive is absent.
limitations: Header check: it also fires when no Content-Security-Policy header is sent. DPK-DAST-002 reports that case. The check cannot see a policy delivered by a meta element.
fpNotes: Pages with no base elements or forms make the gap low-impact; the common false positive.
